2608.28345.title: AGENT-O: A Semantic Agent Card Framework for Interoperable and Governed Healthcare AI Agents
2608.28345.paper_summary: AGENT-O is a modular ontology framework that defines a semantic Agent Card for representing health-oriented AI agent systems and supports assessment of reporting completeness in scientific publications. AGENT-O was developed as an OWL 2/RDF ontology covering runtime, models, workflow, tools, clinical use, evaluation, provenance, governance, and reporting assessment. Evaluation included ontology inventory, OWL-RL reasoning, three SHACL suites, 12 SPARQL competency queries, three cases, and model-assisted reporting-completeness assessment of 279 papers across five dimensions. The ontology contained 1,962 RDF triples and 1,922 Protege axioms, with 252 active classes, 198 active object properties, and 51 datatype properties. All SHACL suites conformed on example graphs, all competency queries returned prespecified evidence, and all 279 papers were scored. Incomplete reporting was highest for runtime/architecture (84.6%), governance/safety (82.8%), and provenance/reproducibility (78.1%), compared with evaluation (25.8%) and benchmark-process alignment (29.8%). AGENT-O supported semantic Agent Card representation and reporting assessment while revealing an evaluation-specification gap: evaluation and benchmark procedures were reported more consistently than runtime architecture, governance, and reproducibility. AGENT-O provides a reusable ontology, semantic Agent Card profile, and reporting-completeness workflow for structured reporting and gap identification, but does not assess agent quality or deployment readiness.
2608.28345.paper_summary_zh: AGENT-O 是一個模組化的本體框架，定義了一個語義代理卡，用於表示以健康為導向的 AI 代理系統，並支持對科學出版物報告完整性的評估。AGENT-O 被開發為一個 OWL 2/RDF 本體，涵蓋了運行時、模型、工作流程、工具、臨床使用、評估、來源、治理和報告評估。評估包括本體清單、OWL-RL 推理、三個 SHACL 套件、12 個 SPARQL 能力查詢、三個案例，以及對 279 篇論文在五個維度上的模型輔助報告完整性評估。該本體包含 1,962 個 RDF 三元組和 1,922 個 Protege 公理，擁有 252 個活躍類別、198 個活躍對象屬性和 51 個數據類型屬性。所有 SHACL 套件在示例圖上均符合，所有能力查詢均返回預先指定的證據，且所有 279 篇論文均已評分。運行時/架構（84.6%）、治理/安全（82.8%）和來源/可重複性（78.1%）的報告不完整性最高，而評估（25.8%）和基準過程對齊（29.8%）則較低。AGENT-O 支持語義代理卡表示和報告評估，同時揭示了評估規範的差距：評估和基準程序的報告一致性高於運行時架構、治理和可重複性。AGENT-O 提供了一個可重用的本體、語義代理卡配置文件和報告完整性工作流程，用於結構化報告和差距識別，但不評估代理質量或部署準備性。
